thread:
Aisha P.: Heads up — invoice generation for Nimbus Labs (period 2026-02-01 to 2026-02-28) looks wrong. The tiered discount line for 'dedicated GPU hours' is missing and the invoice total is ~$12,043 higher than expected. Can someone take a look?

billing-bot: invoice-generator job 2026-03-23T10:02:01Z finished with 1 WARN and 0 ERROR. WARN: 1 invoice(s) generated with missing pricing metadata. Job id: job_20260323_1002

Miguel O.: Invoice id? PDF or raw JSON?

Aisha P.: Invoice id INV-2026-02-09123. PDF: https://payments.internal.redwood/invoices/INV-2026-02-09123.pdf  Raw payload: s3://billing-outputs/2026/02/INV-2026-02-09123.json

Samir G.: I pulled the raw. Looks like the discount calculation pipeline skipped the tiered_discount join when customer.billing_profile->quota_tiers is empty for a subset of usage rows. Quick grep shows a left join that filters on discount_pct IS NOT NULL in a subquery. Might be the NULL handling.

Samir G.: Example problematic fragment from billing-svc (lines trimmed):
```
SELECT u.account_id, u.usage_hours, t.tier_name, t.discount_pct
FROM usage_events u
LEFT JOIN tier_pricing t ON u.account_id = t.account_id
  AND u.usage_hours BETWEEN t.min_hours AND t.max_hours
WHERE t.discount_pct IS NOT NULL -- <- this filter kills rows where tier exists but discount is NULL
```

Jules (Acct): Also: we noticed a duplicate invoice for Nimbus for Feb as well — there are two invoice records (INV-2026-02-09123 and INV-2026-02-09123-dup). Can we be careful reissuing so we don't double-credit? Customer id 789.

Aisha P.: Confirmed duplicate: system shows both IDs, same period. Payment not yet captured.

Miguel O.: Ok two-pronged fix: (1) patch billing-svc to remove the `WHERE t.discount_pct IS NOT NULL` and handle NULL as 0, (2) re-run invoice generation for account 789 only and reconcile duplicates. I'll prepare a hotfix PR.

Miguel O.: To requeue reprocess for just that account run:
```bash
billing-reprocess --account 789 --period 2026-02 --mode regenerate --reason "tiered discount missing"
```

Jules (Acct): While eng works, please create a manual credit memo so the customer isn't charged incorrectly if we accidentally capture payment. Also add a hold on auto-pay for those invoice IDs.

Aisha P.: Created hold on both invoice IDs and flagged for manual review.

billing-bot: action logged: invoice_hold applied on INV-2026-02-09123 by Aisha P. at 2026-03-23T10:08:12Z

Samir G.: PR opened: https://git.internal.redwood/billing-svc/pulls/412 — small fix, adds COALESCE(t.discount_pct, 0) and updates unit tests for tier edge cases. Requesting hotfix deploy to staging then prod. Estimated rollback/QA window ~ 90 mins.

Miguel O.: After deploy I'll trigger the reprocess command above. Plan: reprocess -> run reconciliation job -> generate corrected invoice -> void duplicate -> create credit memo if needed.

Jules (Acct): Please also create a temporary negative line item for the customer to reflect the expected credit so CS has something to show Nimbus. Amount: $12,043.12, reason: "missed tiered discount (Feb 2026)".

Aisha P.: Credit memo created CM-2026-03-0091 for $12,043.12 and linked to the held invoices. Noted in the account activity.

billing-bot: finance-ops ticket created: FIN-4872 "Nimbus Labs — missing tiered discount + duplicate invoice" assigned to Billing Ops.

Samir G.: Deploy to staging completed and tests passing. Pushing to prod in 15. Will ping when finished.

Miguel O.: Reprocess kicked off for account 789 at 2026-03-23T11:24:03Z. Job id job_reproc_789_202602.

billing-bot: job_reproc_789_202602 completed at 2026-03-23T11:37:21Z. Result: invoice regenerated, original duplicate voided, corrected PDF uploaded s3://billing-outputs/2026/02/INV-2026-02-09123-corrected.pdf

Jules (Acct): Verified corrected invoice and credit memo. Will reach out to Nimbus CS to explain and offer reimbursement for any fees. Thanks all.

Aisha P.: Thanks team — closing the loop. Please leave notes in FIN-4872 with postmortem items (root cause: NULL discount handling; action: add QA for tiered discounts + reconcile duplicate detection). :thumbsup:
